variants.headline: Still in view: party walks out of government
variants.sub: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement.
variants.body:
The party {party} has walked out of the government. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

There is a principled question beneath every argument about staying in office: what makes cooperation worth sustaining? Our movement should answer it honestly. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
